result.topic_en: A table of values for the years 1818.0–1819.0 with corrections, followed by formulas for computing nutation in right ascension and declination.

methods.what: Auxiliary nutation coefficients a and b defined from the longitude of the Sun/node symbol with constant alpha = M/50 and N (given as logarithms)
Nutation correction in right ascension expressed via the coefficients a, b
Nutation correction in declination expressed via the coefficients a, b
Tabulation of a quantity at tenth-year intervals 1818.0–1819.0 decreasing by about 1.96 per step, with accompanying correction columns
